name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
description: A traditional Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and black pepper.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil, and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
While the pasta cooks, heat a large skillet over medium heat, and cook the pancetta until crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, egg yolk, both cheeses, and black pepper.
When the pasta is done, reserve about 1/2 cup of pasta water, then drain the pasta.
Working quickly, add the hot pasta to the skillet with the pancetta, and toss to coat in the rendered fat.
Remove the skillet from heat, and pour in the egg mixture, tossing continuously until the eggs thicken but don't scramble.
If needed, add a splash of the reserved pasta water to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra grated cheese and freshly ground black pepper.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A quick and healthy vegetable stir fry that's perfect for weeknight dinners.
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Add garlic and ginger and stir fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the harder vegetables first (broccoli and carrots), and stir fry for 2 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and snap peas, and continue to stir fry for another 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and sesame oil, and toss to coat all vegetables.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Serve hot over cooked rice.

name: Classic Beef Burger
description: Juicy homemade beef burgers with all the fixings.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix ground beef, diced onion, minced garlic, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions and form into patties slightly larger than your burger buns, as they will shrink when cooking.
Make a small indentation in the center of each patty with your thumb to prevent it from puffing up during cooking.
Heat a grill, grill pan, or skillet to medium-high heat.
Cook the patties for about 4 minutes on the first side.
Flip the patties and cook for another 3-5 minutes, depending on desired doneness.
If adding cheese, place a slice on each patty during the last minute of cooking.
Lightly toast the burger buns.
Assemble the burgers with lettuce, tomato, and condiments of your choice.

name: Avocado Toast
description: Simple but delicious avocado toast, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Toast the bread slices to your desired level of crispness.
Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Add lemon juice and salt to the avocado, and mash with a fork to your preferred consistency.
Spread the avocado mixture onto the toast.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with red pepper flakes if using.

name: Butter Chicken Curry
description: A rich, creamy, and flavorful North Indian curry that's perfect for cold days.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix yogurt, lemon juice, ginger paste, garlic paste, 1 tsp garam masala, turmeric, cumin, coriander powder, and chili powder.
Add chicken pieces to the marinade, mix well to coat, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour (preferably 4+ hours).
In a large pot or pan, melt 2 tbsp of butter over medium-high heat.
Add the marinated chicken (reserving excess marinade) and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add remaining butter. Once melted, add the chopped onions and sauté until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the reserved marinade and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add tomato puree and cook for 10-15 minutes until the sauce thickens and oil begins to separate at the edges.
Return the chicken to the pot and simmer on low heat for 15-20 minutes, until chicken is thoroughly cooked.
Stir in the heavy cream, remaining garam masala, kasoori methi, sugar, and salt to taste. Simmer for another 5-10 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with basmati rice and naan bread.
